english.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for a physical place or part of a surface.
Use this for a place or area when emphasizing where something is rather than its exact position.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for referring to the place or buildings where something happens.
Use 地方 as the all-purpose word for a place, locality, area, or location.
This is the all-purpose choice for a place or location, rather than a mark on a surface.
Use this for an unspecified area, region, or district rather than a country or rural countryside.
Use this when “land” means a region or place in general, rather than a sovereign country.
